info.title: NoshGuard Sanctions & Crypto Wallet Screening API
info.description: Screen people, companies, vessels and crypto wallets against OFAC (SDN + Consolidated), UN, EU and UK sanctions lists in one call, with fuzzy multilingual matching, DOB and country filters and batch screening. Lists refresh every 6 hours.

get.description: Exact match against every digital currency address on the OFAC SDN list (Bitcoin, Ethereum and EVM chains, Tron, USDT, Monero, Litecoin, Solana and more). EVM and bech32 addresses match case-insensitively; base58 addresses match exactly.
